stem.en: The athlete is at the 130 m mark at t = 9 s, and later stops at the 90 m mark at t = 15 s. What time interval (in s) elapsed between these two instants?

explanation.en: A time interval is the duration between two clock readings, not a position value. Time interval = 15 s - 9 s = 6 s.

hints.en: An instant of time is a single clock reading; a time interval is the gap between two such readings. Subtract the earlier instant from the later one.
